scope: Actual compiled UI and isolated SQLite API/worker; only discovery and virtual transport are redirected to owned loopback processes. Generated accounts, not public demo credentials.
checks: Super Admin unsaved rules survive a reload review, Keep editing preserves the draft, explicit discard/reload releases navigation, and invalid/unchanged policies cannot be submitted.

Real verification rejects and revokes a valid different-account session, then verifies the original generated account on the pinned service, revokes its old token and preserves the mounted unconfirmed policy request.

An actual committed policy with a deliberately lost receipt retains its original payload/key after a controlled non-committing403 retry denial and real same-account verification; a final same-key origin receipt creates only one revision. The denial is injected transport evidence, not an actual five-minute expiry test. Original rules are restored.
Actual activity requests retain the chosen club/team scope, return only attributed team events, and support 24-hour, 30-day and 7-day ranges.
Super Admin opens global activity, selects account/event filters, clears them and visits active/events/overview panels with real observed sign-in coverage and a UK-time successful receipt.
Club and application-wide privilege changes show target/scope before submission; cancel makes no grant, accepted changes are verified and reversed, and self-revocation remains disabled.
Super Admin creates a real isolated club and U12 team, verifies empty-team isolation and inherited Manager access, grants/revokes an existing verified adult, and reviews the new club report.

Super Admin visits Teams, overview, schedule, aggregate stats, People, seasons, opposition notes, configuration, invitations/access requests, club reports and Account through the actual compact navigation.

Super Admin Account provides readable access/help/privacy and records an explicitly confirmed own-account export request as pending verification/policy only; no fulfilment, erasure or membership change occurs.
Super Admin creates a real one-hour team/season spectator link, renders its QR locally, closes the secret display and explicitly revokes the invitation. No email/share message is sent.

Phone 390 and tablet 1024 fit in the staff phone/tablet modes; Club Admin cannot read global policy/activity, anonymous access is denied, and Super Admin logout revokes the session and closes private views.
